purpose: Single source of truth for the Nabaperks CR80 NFC card registry, copy, and native CR80 print pages (85.5 × 54 mm). Cards are venue-branded: merchant name, stamps required, and the permanent join URL. Honest by contract — no free-stamp claims, no receipt claims, and first-stamp copy matches the OTP + terms join funnel.

product.kitSummary: One print-ready CR80 NFC card — front and back as 85.5 × 54 mm pages.

collection.name: CR80 NFC cards
collection.description: Tap cards for counters, tills and guest hand-out — front and back print at CR80 size (85.5 × 54 mm).

shared.reassurance: 18+ to redeem · One visit stamp here per UK date · Rewards redeem from the next weekday · Terms apply

qr.productionRule: Front QR encodes the venue share URL with src=qr. Program the NFC chip with the same path using src=nfc so analytics can distinguish tap from scan. Preserve square modules; proof tap and scan on representative phones.
